answer: Only a lived past opens this gate, and Postal address history with postal service attestation is the proof: an address held for years and confirmed by the postal service. The ledge is the anchor in the physical world — something a script cannot conjure and a verifier can test without trusting the claimant. A farm must reproduce it a hundred times, and the lotus in each copy is the cost of the real thing, paid in money and years. The spiral is the test result: pass and you are in.
